messages.content: A warehouse has three conveyor lines A, B, C fed by one shared sorter. The sorter runs a fixed cycle: it serves A, then B, then C, then repeats. Serving a line takes 4 minutes, except every third time it serves B it takes 7 minutes due to a mandatory clean. Line A receives 120 crates/hour, line B 90, line C 60; each line's buffer holds 40 crates and overflows if the backlog exceeds that while the line is waiting. A shift starts at 08:00 with all buffers empty and the sorter starting its cycle at A. Work out exactly, minute by minute if needed, whether any buffer overflows before 10:00, and if so which line first and at what time. Reason at full thoroughness before answering; verify each accumulation step.
